an5.159:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an5.159:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā udāyi mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinno hoti.
an5.159:1.4: addasā kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ desentaṃ nisinnaṃ
an5.159:1.5: disvāna yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.159:1.6: āyasmā bhante udāyi mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ desento nisinnoti.
an5.159:2.1: na kho ānanda sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ
an5.159:2.2: paresaṃ ānanda dhammaṃ desentena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo
an5.159:2.5: pariyāyadassāvī kathaṃ kathessāmīti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo
an5.159:2.6: anudayataṃ paṭicca kathaṃ kathessāmīti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo
an5.159:2.7: na āmisantaro kathaṃ kathessāmīti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo
an5.159:2.8: attānañca parañca anupahacca kathaṃ kathessāmīti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.
an5.159:2.9: na kho ānanda sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ
an5.159:2.10: paresaṃ ānanda dhammaṃ desentena ime pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabboti.
